display.purpose: Menu titles: FRONTAL FORCE, PAUSED, K.I.A.

data.purpose: Ammo and health numerals — data beats prose mid-combat.

body.purpose: Menu key list, death stats, hint copy.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action: DEPLOY, RESUME, REDEPLOY.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 700 16px/1 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: #fff; padding: 13px 44px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #5f8cff); border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(95,140,255,0.35), rgba(95,140,255,0.12)); cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(95,140,255,0.35); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #5f8cff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary/destructive-neutral action: ABANDON RUN, MAIN MENU.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font: 700 13px/1 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: rgba(200,214,255,0.62); padding: 13px 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(140,170,255,0.22); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(140,170,255,0.06); cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #e8eeff; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(140,170,255,0.18); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #5f8cff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: HUD Chip
components.description: Top status readout: SCORE / BEST / WAVE / KILLS.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font: 400 13px/1 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #e8eeff; padding: 6px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(140,170,255,0.22); border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(8,12,22,0.62); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); } .ds-chip--wave { color: var(--accent, #5f8cff); border-color: rgba(95,140,255,0.35); }

components.name: Menu Card
components.description: Full-screen overlay container for menu, pause, and death screens.
components.css: .ds-menu-card { background: rgba(8,12,22,0.62); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); border: 1px solid rgba(140,170,255,0.22); border-radius: 14px; padding: 42px 56px; box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); text-align: center; } .ds-menu-card__title { font: 700 32px/1.1 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.3em; color: #e8eeff; text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(95,140,255,0.35); }

components.name: Integrity Bar
components.description: Player health readout; turns crimson below 30%.
components.css: .ds-health { width: 300px; height: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(140,170,255,0.22); background: rgba(6,10,20,0.7); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-health__fill { height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #38e08c, #7dffb8); transition: width 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-health__fill.low { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff4d5e, #ff8a5e); }

components.name: Crosshair
components.description: Signature dynamic crosshair; gap widens with movement and firing.
components.css: .ds-crosshair { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 40px; --gap: 4px; } .ds-crosshair i { position: absolute; background: rgba(232,238,255,0.92); box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(95,140,255,0.35); } .ds-crosshair .t, .ds-crosshair .b { left: 19px; width: 2px; height: 9px; } .ds-crosshair .l, .ds-crosshair .r { top: 19px; width: 9px; height: 2px; } .ds-crosshair .t { top: 19px; transform: translateY(calc(-1 * var(--gap) - 100%)); } .ds-crosshair .b { top: 19px; transform: translateY(var(--gap)); } .ds-crosshair .l { left: 19px; transform: translateX(calc(-1 * var(--gap) - 100%)); } .ds-crosshair .r { left: 19px; transform: translateX(var(--gap)); transition: transform 0.08s ease-out; } .ds-crosshair .dot { left: 19px; top: 19px; width: 2px; height: 2px; border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Hint Bar
components.description: Contextual caution line (reload, low ammo, low integrity).
components.css: .ds-hint { font: 400 12px/1 'Chakra Petch', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: #ffd98a; padding: 7px 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,200,90,0.4); background: rgba(20,14,6,0.72); border-radius: 6px; display: inline-block; }

narrative.overview: The HUD behaves like the readout etched into an operator's helmet: terse, high-contrast, stenciled. Panels are translucent near-black glass over the arena with hairline periwinkle edges; anything active earns a glow rather than a drop shadow. Color is rationed — cobalt for interaction and wave state, crimson for damage, green for recovery, amber for caution, gold for achievement. Every animation reports state and has a reduced-motion equivalent.
keyCharacteristics: Stenciled wide-tracked labels, oversized data numerals
Translucent panels with hairline borders; glow as the only elevation language
Signal color rationing — each hue owns one gameplay meaning
Motion as feedback only, with prefers-reduced-motion parity

rules.name: The Signal-Only Rule
rules.body: A hue may only appear when it carries gameplay or interaction meaning; anything else stays neutral.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every container edge is a 1px #8caaff38 border — never a thick stripe, never border-left as accent.

rules.name: The Stencil Rule
rules.body: Uppercase + tracking >= 0.14em is reserved for labels, chips, and buttons; prose stays sentence case.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: Hover and active states emit accent light; they never translate, scale, or bounce (1px nudge ceiling).

dos: Do keep the Signal-Only Rule: color only where gameplay meaning exists.
Do use 1px hairlines for every container edge.
Do express hover/active as accent glow, <=1px translation.
Do keep 2px accent focus-visible outlines on every interactive element.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: opacity-only feedback, no infinite pulses.
donts: Don't ship AI-template UI: default palettes, hero-metric cards, section eyebrows, numbered 01/02 scaffolding.
Don't use decorative glassmorphism — backdrop blur only on panels over live gameplay for legibility.
Don't use gradient text or side-stripe borders.
Don't look playful or casual-arcade: no bounce/elastic easing, no cartoon colors.
Don't add over-decorated gamer chrome: no scanlines, no glow on non-interactive elements.
Don't put display tracking on prose or body copy.
